rating.comments: The first student message is the task question and is ignored. The student's later messages are "of the density" (a bare answer, possibly echoing the AI's earlier density point) and "when its more dens or less dens ?", which asks which direction density relates to speed, a content question about the task. The student gives no reasons of their own and only fragmentary replies, so reasoning is a single stated guess and knowledge building is at most an echo of the AI's content.
